## 6. Lessons from this session

- **Live runs find what unit tests don't:** both bugs came from the real system's shape (11 collections) and from code that reads every key of a dict.
- **Don't use `git stash -- <path>` to test a revert** on this tree: it failed on the staged `config/safety.yaml` (`git add -N` files). A one-line `sed` revert and restore works, but scope it to one line number, because the same text appears at two sites in `discovery.py`.
- **In zsh, `set -- $VAR` doesn't word-split.** Use `read a b <<< "$VAR"` in poll loops.
